# Credits {.unnumbered}

The chapter list was constructed by surveying publicly
available version-control teaching materials from major
data-science and biostatistics courses, including Jenny
Bryan's *Happy Git and GitHub for the useR*, the Software
Carpentry version-control lessons, and university course
modules at Cornell (INFO 5940), Carnegie Mellon
(Statistical Computing), and American University (DATA
413/613), and adopting the topics common to the majority of
them.

Cover artwork generated procedurally by the R script at
`images/build-cover.R`. Watercolour palette: deep rust
through terracotta and amber to pale sand, anchored on a
brand rust `#8f3a1a` chosen to echo the Git project's
signature orange. Typography: Avenir family (Apple system
font); body text in Source Serif 4.
